about_the_game:
Nine Heavens Dragon Control Art Game Introduction

Nine Heavens Dragon Control Art creates a passionate combat experience with its unique Chinese-style silhouette art style.

Players will transform into distinctive heroes such as Zhao Yun, embarking on a dragon-riding adventure in the fantasy world of the "Nine Heavens". The game integrates diverse gameplay mechanics including character development and combat — from equipment forging to divine pet cultivation, from skill matching to dungeon challenges — all helping players create a personalized combat style. In richly designed levels like the "Trial Grounds", players can enjoy the thrill of clearing stages. Additionally, they can participate in welfare activities such as the "7-Day Check-In" and "Lucky Spin Wheel", gaining surprises while growing stronger and writing their own passionate dragon-riding combat story.

Characters & Development

Hero Settings

At the start, players can choose from classic heroes (e.g., Zhao Yun). The heroes feature Chinese-style silhouette designs in their appearances, which are unique and recognizable. Some heroes can even unlock exclusive dragon-riding forms. Through the "Equipment", "Skills", "Martial Soul", and "Divine Pet" systems, players can enhance their combat power in an all-round way:

  • Equipment enhancement boosts basic attributes;

  • Skill matching determines combat styles (e.g., focusing on dragon-riding crowd control or single-target burst damage);

  • Martial Souls grant special bonuses (such as the "Dragon Power Martial Soul" increasing damage against demons);

  • Divine Pets assist in battles (some of which are dragon-shaped companions capable of unleashing group dragon breath skills).
    Together, these form a multi-dimensional development pathway.

Development Path

Starting from strengthening basic attributes like "Attack Power" and "Health", players can gradually unlock in-depth development content — such as obtaining high-tier dragon-shaped divine pets and advancing Martial Souls (e.g., unlocking the "Nine Heavens Dragon Martial Soul"). This allows them to customize distinctive combat characters: whether they aim to build a "Dragon-Riding War God" or an "All-Round Guardian", they can find their exclusive growth direction.

Featured Systems

Welfare Activities

Activities like "7-Day Check-In", "Lucky Spin Wheel", and "Daily Quests" provide channels for resource acquisition. Low-threshold welfare helps new players get started quickly (for example, players can receive primary dragon-scale equipment on the second day of check-in to rapidly boost combat power).

Lottery Gameplay

"Qimen Lottery" and "Divine Pet Gift Packs" add a sense of randomness and collection fun. Players have the chance to obtain rare development materials (such as "Dragon Marrow Crystals" used for divine pet breakthroughs) and dragon-shaped divine pets, accelerating the process of building a powerful combat team.
